definition: An adapter protein encoded by the YWHAZ gene that participates in diverse signaling pathways governing cellular proliferation, migration, and differentiation; variants in this protein lead to neurodevelopmental phenotypes including intellectual disability, global developmental delay, and Popov-Chang syndrome.

source.quote: YWHAZ encodes an adapter protein 14-3-3ζ, which is involved in many signaling pathways that control cellular proliferation, migration and differentiation.
